quotes.text: Conditional access is a policy engine that checks context before letting someone in. It doesn't just look at your password and say good enough.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

From security defaults to custom policies

takeaways: Conditional Access evaluates signals such as identity, location, device, app and sign-in risk after the password check and turns a flat yes or no into a layered decision.
Every tenant should start with three baseline policies: strong MFA for all users, blocking legacy authentication and compliant devices for admins.
Create break-glass accounts first, test new policies in report-only mode and with the What If tool, and roll them out in phases.
hook: A stolen password should not be enough to walk into your Microsoft 365 tenant. This episode explains Conditional Access in plain English for admins and IT decision makers: the signals it checks, how policies decide, and which baseline policies to deploy first. You will also learn how to roll out policies safely without locking yourself out.
